shared_elements: boat/ship in profile with upturned prow and stern
row of vertical crew-strokes rising from the hull line
multiple ships of differing sizes on one rock surface
justification: Both surfaces depict the same highly conventional motif: a profile boat with strongly upturned prow and stern, its hull drawn as parallel lines with a comb-like row of short vertical crew-strokes above, plus schematic stick-figure humans and smaller repeated ships scattered over the same rock panel. The main difference is content emphasis and density: A is dominated by one very large, elaborately detailed vessel with a second smaller boat below, while B spreads several small ships, a horned/antlered quadruped-like figure and a line of three armed figures across an open surface.
